title: Which Prepaid Portions Count Toward a HECM Reinstatement Restoration
content:
Cedarline counts the prepaid portions toward the reinstatement restoration of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan by how the cured case was put right. The cured case is the loan's maturity case in its Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases records named by the most recent cure confirmation notice; whether a repayment plan stands is read from the loan's Property Charge Advance Repayment record.

| Cured maturity case | Property charge repayment record on the loan | Portions counted (posted as restoring nothing to the line) |
|---|---|---|
| Property Charge Default | none active — the arrearage having been repaid | every portion, whatever its allocation bucket (premium, servicing fee, interest, principal) |
| Property Charge Default | one active — the cure resting on a repayment plan | the principal and interest portions |
| any other case type (for example Death of Last Surviving Borrower or Extended Health-Care Absence) | any | only the principal portions |

**Hypothetical portions:** principal 3000.00, interest 1200.00, premium 500.00, servicing fee 300.00.

- Property Charge Default cure, no active repayment record: 5000.00 counted.
- Property Charge Default cure, an active repayment record: 4200.00 counted.
- Sale or Title Transfer case cured: 3000.00 counted.
